# EventCell v0.6.1 - Table of Contents

BEAM-native coordinate event store. Append-only segment files, ETS indexes, BLAKE3 hash chains.

## Pages

- [EventCell](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Architecture](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/architecture.md)
- [Mental Model](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/mental_model.md)
- [Quick Start](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/quick_start.md)
- [Format Versions](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/format_versions.md)
- [Operations](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/operations.md)

## Modules

- Public API
  - [EventCell](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.md): BEAM-native coordinate event store.
  - [EventCell.Store](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Store.md): Public API facade for an EventCell store.

- Data Types
  - [EventCell.Coordinate](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Coordinate.md): 4D coordinate struct for addressing events.
  - [EventCell.Entry](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Entry.md): Immutable event entry with BLAKE3 hash chains.
  - [EventCell.Entry.Ref](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Entry.Ref.md): Lightweight index entry stored in ETS (no payload in memory).

- Storage
  - [EventCell.Segment](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Segment.md): Pure functions for the segment binary format.
  - [EventCell.Segment.Reader](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Segment.Reader.md): GenServer managing read-only file descriptors for segment files with LRU eviction.
  - [EventCell.Segment.Writer](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Segment.Writer.md): GenServer that owns the active segment file descriptor.

- Index
  - [EventCell.Index](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Index.md): ETS-backed multi-dimension index for coordinate event lookups.
  - [EventCell.Symbols](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Symbols.md): ETS-backed string interning with atomics counter.

- Infrastructure
  - [EventCell.Application](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Application.md): EventCell application entry point. Starts registries for process naming and entity locking.
  - [EventCell.Config](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Config.md): Runtime configuration with validation.
  - [EventCell.Snapshot](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Snapshot.md): ETS snapshot take/load/replay for fast cold start.
  - [EventCell.Supervisor](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Supervisor.md): Per-store OTP supervisor for `Segment.Writer` and `Segment.Reader`.

- Features
  - [EventCell.Auditor](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Auditor.md): Periodic GenServer that samples random entity chains and segment entries
for integrity verification.
  - [EventCell.Compaction](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Compaction.md): Rewrites sealed segments in entity-sorted order to improve read locality.
  - [EventCell.Subscription](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Subscription.md): Pattern-matched pub/sub with process monitoring and backpressure.

- Optional
  - [EventCell.Telemetry](https://event-cell.hexdocs.pm/EventCell.Telemetry.md): Optional integration with the `:telemetry` library.
